title: Efficient photocatalytic reactors via 3D printing: SLA fabrication and TiO2 hybrid materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2275-2286
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07121B, Paper
Open Access

Isabel S. O. Barbosa, Yaidelin A. Manrique, Diana Paiva, Joaquim L. Faria, Ricardo J. Santos, Cláudia G. Silva
Additive Manufacturing using SLA was used to create 3D-printed photocatalytic reactors with TiO2-P25, achieving efficient RhB degradation. This approach offers a cost-effective, rapid method for immobilizing photocatalysts for several applications.
